name: Oo! Imouto no Ana Kyun ~Gakkou no Youmuin mo~
original_name: おおぉ!妹の穴キュン～学校の用務員も～
source:
An adventure game with female voices in which you are to have sex with your young sister in school.
The story can be played from both brother's side and young sister's side.
It also features 2 stories of the sister getting penetrated by a school janitor. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE004098.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一款女声冒险游戏，你将在学校里与你的妹妹发生性关系。
这个故事可以从兄弟这边和妹妹这边来播放。
它还讲述了妹妹被学校看门人插入的两个故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE004098.html]DLsite English[/url]]
